text:
maya.marketing: Heads up — we need a compact set of benchmark tiles + a webinar hero and one‑pager template for the "Inference Economics" webinar next Wednesday. Goal: visuals for email, social squares, webinar slide hero, and a single PDF one‑pager. Ask: 3 visual variants (high-contrast, photo+overlay, and icon/grid), Figma file with export presets, and an accessibility/brand pass. Delivery target: EOD Tue (48h).

leo.design: Got it. Can you confirm sizes? I assume: email hero 1200x628, social square 1080x1080, slide hero 1920x1080, one-pager A4 (print PDF). Any other sizes?

maya.marketing: Yup those. Also need a tiny microtile 300x300 for inline blog embeds. And a 600x200 banner for in-product promo. Please follow the brand palette but push the contrast for legibility on small text (esp sparkline labels).

sam_growth: Quick routing note — assets must include UTM-ready masters. We route webinar signups to /events?utm_source=email&utm_campaign=inference_econ and inbound demo leads to HubSpot form id=2034. Can you embed a small footer area on the one-pager for CTA + legal link?

leo.design: Re: accessibility — I'll run the color combos through axe contrast rules. If core brand color fails WCAG AA at 14px, I'll propose 2 alternate color overlays. Also: do you want the tile variants to show actual perf numbers or placeholder copy?

maya.marketing: Use real numbers for the benchmark tiles — I've attached the latest snapshot (p95 latency / cost per 1k tokens / throughput). Put a small legend: metric label + value + unit. Keep the numbers as live text (not flattened) so we can update later.

oliver.design: Figma plan — I'll create a master component set with tokens for color, spacing, and typography. Export presets: PNG @1x for social, PNG @2x for hero retina, SVG for icons, and PDF export for one-pager. Naming convention: inference-econ_variant-size_assetrole (e.g., inference-econ_high-contrast_1080x1080_tile1). Ok?

jen.legal: Quick brand compliance / legal note: any benchmark claims need a tiny footnote if derived from internal tests. Please add: "Benchmark: internal Redwood Inference tests; results may vary by workload." Also route final assets to legal@redwood.com for a quick sweep before publish. We need file-level versioning (v1, v2) in filenames.

leo.design: Cool. I'll sketch three thumbnails in the next 5 hours and share a Figma link. For export, here's a tiny build script snippet I'll use for batch exports so QA can reproduce:```bash
# export PNGs
figma-export --file FILE_KEY --output ./exports --format png --scale 1,2
# export SVGs
figma-export --file FILE_KEY --output ./exports --format svg
```

maya.marketing: Perfect. One more ask: can we get a social tile variant that omits the numeric legend (clean visual) to A/B test engagement vs click-through (variant A: numbers visible; variant B: headline-only). We'll run 7-day test post-send.

sam_growth: Added — growth will tag the variants with utm_content=nums and utm_content=clean. Also confirm the webinar signup flow will append hs_lead_source=inference_econ. Oliver/Leo, can you add a hidden tracking field space on the one-pager PDF export (tiny footer line for UTM examples)?

oliver.design: Yep — I'll include a sample footer mock with the UTM placeholders and export a PDF with a hidden text layer (so copy/paste preserves the link).

leo.design: sharing initial thumbnails: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/inference-econ-bench (will update). Feedback welcome.

maya.marketing: This looks great. Priorities: 1) high-contrast tile + social square 2) slide hero 3) one-pager PDF with footer and legal note. If timelines slip, push slide hero first — that's for the webinar title slide.

jen.legal: Thanks — I'll review the first pass once you tag legal in the Figma comments. If we need to change claim language I'll flag it inline.

maya.marketing: Thanks team — please ping here for any blockers. :thumbsup:
